card.name: Age and dose ranges in dosing text
card.fires_on: The start of an age or dose figure in dosing sections: a digit or number word that begins a range, a dash inside an age range, or the start of 'Elderly'. It is strongest for pediatric and geriatric age groups.

modes.label: Age range start
modes.description: A number or dash opening an age range for children.

modes.label: Dose range start
modes.description: The first number of a dose range or multiple.

card.plain: It lights up on the first number of an age or dose range, or on the start of 'elderly', in dosing instructions.
